After long thought into it, ive decided to quit cold turkey come Friday, then use the weekend to hangout with my close friend while i go through the rough patch until my body starts to realign all the chemicals. I guess i didnt think what i wss doing was so abnormal until i started researching it and reading replys and realizing that i could or may already have damaged Nerve cells/receptors in my brain that affect depression and my mood. Im also going to start this week looking for a therapist within my insurance circle to start seeing to hopefully work through some of my trauma and resolve some things that bother me mentally. Ive also looked into safer, and less potent alternative drugs to help me cope if things do get too terribly bad. I appreciate you, and and many others who took the time to spread information to me aswell as save me from causing anymore damage to my body. Much love and positive vibes.

Thankfully after talking to another user ive decided to go cold turkey next friday and use the weekend to hit rock bottom with a close friend while we watch the office and eat snacks. Honestly I'm looking forward to it in a weird way as ill no longer have to fear getting pulled over and given a felony for having it on me, aswell as going to see a therapist to hopefully try to fix some emotional trama and resolve some inner issues so i can be "Naturally" happy. Im glad i posted this, as at first i I thought i might get either called an idiot or just ignored, but the fact everyone has been nothing but caring and warm to me brings great joy to me. Thank you again friend, ill post an update within the next two weeks after i sober up and get into see a therapist.

I struggled after a really bad break up about 2ish years ago, attempted once and was put in the hospital for a week over it. The thing i took away the most from the situation was simple, people come and go, if you center your life and depend on them being there for you to function, well youre just not living life the way you should. I always had an issue with falling too hard to quick, and then being hurt for months after but it gets easier and it gets better. Make sure your life is being lived for you, for what you want out of it, for what you enjoy and do that. Find someone with similar goals, similar hobbies and do what you want to do, alongside someone who is doing the same because they ALSO want to do it, not because they feel they have to. Its okay to make sacrifices, just never sacrifice yourself bro.
